newsitem.title: FRANCE: Young French doctors on protest march.
newsitem.headline: Young French doctors on protest march.

text.p: Several thousand junior hospital doctors staged a noisy but peaceful march through Paris on Sunday in protest against social security reforms which they fear will cut their future earnings.
Police said 4,000 people took part in the march but participants said there were more.

The junior doctors, recent graduates of medical schools training in hospitals, are protesting against new government rules aimed at limiting medical spending by the country's comprehensive but hugely indebted social security system.
The young doctors say the rules will result in their future earnings being capped to unacceptably low levels when they open private practises.
Their unions say about 80 percent of the 7,500 doctors falling into their category are on strike.

The march follows a similar protest by hospital workers who marched through Paris on Friday protesting against budget curbs which they say will mean less equipment for hospitals and increasingly difficult working conditions.
